en: Conditioned by a state that is not acquired by clinging and is not subject to clinging, and is neither wholesome, a wholesome state that is not acquired by clinging but is subject to clinging arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six under root; ... [and so on] ... six under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is not acquired by clinging and is not subject to clinging, and is unwholesome, an unwholesome state that is not acquired by clinging but is subject to clinging arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... [and so on] ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not acquired by clinging but is subject to clinging and is indeterminate, there arises a state that is not acquired by clinging, is subject to clinging, and is indeterminate, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five; under predominance condition there are five … [and so on] … under non-disappearance condition there are five.
